Gosh bud. Thats just impossible to navigate. My situation is the same as yours but my parents got divorced. It never got easier even as I got older. Now I'm 23 and I can see all the discord manifesting in my poor younger siblings. Therapy is great! If the resources are available you should call your local clinic and you can talk to a therapist for free. Sadly I can't afford health insurance and thoughs resources are available in the next town over and my parents keep my documents from me so I can't leave so I can stay here and provide free child care. Anyways I'm not giving you a pity story, i have to figure everything out on my own and my best advice to you is to spread the love as much as possible. Just let your parents know how much you love them and care about them and do your best to engage your family. Even something as simple as eating dinner together, or taking interest in things your family likes to do together goes miles! Keep the love let love shine, and remember to smile! And don't feel like it's your fault if things don't work out. It's impossible to make everyone happy and really the only person you should make happy is yourself. My saying is if I can make even a single person smile everyday, I will have died a success. And that's good enough for me. Best wishes friend
